beside_separator.verdict: The input is invalid in Java. This is a lost rejection, not a rejection the merge base already missed.
beside_separator.why: StateDiagram.concurrentState (StateDiagram.java:201-204) asks quarkInContext for the short name from getUniqueSequence2, whose first value is CONC2 (CucaDiagram.java:816-818). quarkInContext reuses the one existing quark of that short name when it is not the current group (CucaDiagram.java:266-272). gotoGroup then muteToGroupType(CONCURRENT_STATE) on that quark (CucaDiagram.java:355-356). The top-level state CONC2, which already contains Pier, becomes the concurrent group. The root link on line 9 fails checkConcurrentStateOkInternal (StateDiagram.java:84-87) because Pier's parent is now a concurrent region and the current group is the root.
beside_separator.why_base_matched: The merge base rejected the same link because parent_is_concurrent tested a CONC name prefix on the parent id CONC2. It did not reuse the quark or change the group's type.
beside_separator.why_tip_accepts: The tip records region ids created by the separator. The synthetic id is House.CONC2, so the user state CONC2 is an ordinary composite and the link to Pier is allowed.
beside_separator.not_fixed_here: Restoring the prefix test would reject region_user_concourse and region_user_conc4 again. Those now match Java. The rejection Java actually performs is the quark reuse above, which is the same unfixed identity collision as the region-0 CONC2 panic.

conc2_region0_child.source: state House { state CONC2 -- state Wing } then [*] --> CONC2
conc2_region0_child.base_panic: crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs:6842 on the merge-base binary, same len 4 index 4
conc2_region0_child.mechanism: The user id House.CONC2 is the same string as the synthetic region id. layout_index_of finds that id in layout_node_ids and indexes node_positions one past the end. Java does not allocate a second entity: countByName("CONC2") is 1, so the separator reuses the child quark and mutes it to CONCURRENT_STATE.
conc2_region0_child.proposed_target: A separator reuses the single existing quark of the synthetic short name and mutes that quark to GroupType.CONCURRENT_STATE, as quarkInContext and gotoGroup do, and layout does not panic when a region-0 child carries that short name.
